t: This is St Dunstan's College in Catford, south-east London, a co-educational private day school and a registered charity. It runs a junior school for children aged three to ten, a senior school for eleven to sixteen, and a sixth form for sixteen to eighteen. The school is recorded as founded by Henry VI, who became King of England at just nine months old after the death of his father, Henry V. He reigned from 1422 to 1461 and again from 1470 to 1471, and also claimed the French throne.
